text:
mira: pushed a PR that reworks the starterkit credential flow + docker quickstart. need a quick smoke across py/js snippets and the docker env var naming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523
pr-bot: PR #4523 opened by mira — labels: docs, starterkit, needs-review
sam: on it. which SDK versions should i test against?
mira: py: 1.4.0, js: 2.0.1. note: i normalized env var to REDWOOD_KEY (used to be REDWOOD_API_KEY) — want to avoid breaking changes but wanted a shorter name. please flag any remaining references.
jamie: i'll grep the docs site for REDWOOD_API_KEY and send quick fixes if i find leftovers.
sam: running local smoke now. quick check: example snippet in PR shows this:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"]) 
resp = client.generate("Hello")
print(resp.text)
```
sam: looks fine, but current python SDK 1.4.0 uses `Client(token=...)` not `api_key=` — that's causing the sample to fail in my run.
mira: oh good catch. i must've mixed older examples. i'll update the snippet to use `token=`.
leo: also saw the Console quickstart page still mentions REDWOOD_API_KEY in the creds instructions. i'll file a tiny docs PR to replace that string.
jamie: found two occurrences in /docs/getting-started/credentials.md and one in /docs/starterkit/docker.md — i'll patch them in a followup to this PR to keep changes small.
sam: after switching to Client(token=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"]) the py sample runs and the docker quickstart spins up. one minor: dockerfile in PR sets ENV REDWOOD_KEY="" but the run command in docs uses `-e REDWOOD_API_KEY` — needs sync.
mira: thanks — i pushed a small commit in the PR that updates the docker run example to `-e REDWOOD_KEY`. linking the diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523/files
ci-bot: build/test for PR #4523 — checks started
pr-bot: requested reviewers: sam, jamie, leo
sam: left a couple of one-line comments on the PR (snippet param, inline note about backward compat). overall looks good. :thumbsup:
jamie: patched the two docs files, opened #4524 to avoid bloating #4523 — small string replace + link fix.
leo: i'll review #4524 and merge if green.
ci-bot: CI passed for #4523 (unit + lint)
mira: awesome — can someone merge #4523 once #4524 is merged? want this on staging before tomorrow's onboarding demo.
sam: merging #4524 now, then i'll merge #4523 after a quick smoke post-merge.
pr-bot: PR #4524 merged by jamie
sam: merged #4523 and confirmed starterkit quickstart works end-to-end on staging.
mira: thank you all — leaving a note in the release checklist to watch for any user reports about env var name change. will add a migration blurb in the changelog.
leo: added a short migration note in /docs/whats-new.md about REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY.
mira: perfect. closing this thread — great collaboration! :rocket:
